title: Start a Mineral Water Business in Pakistan: Real Cost (2026)
description:
How much does it really cost to start a mineral water plant in Pakistan? In this episode we break down the two business models (19-litre home and office delivery vs an automatic small-bottle line), how the water is actually made, real costs from a Government of Pakistan feasibility study and a 2026 supplier guide, the PSQCA licence, and rule #1 before you buy any machine.

0:00 Who fills Pakistan's water bottles?
0:09 Welcome to MERI Industry
0:21 Two very different water businesses
0:39 How mineral water is made
1:28 Cost of a small 19-litre plant
1:58 Cost of an automatic bottling line
2:12 The biggest running cost: plastic
2:24 The PSQCA licence
2:40 Which model should you start?
2:54 Rule #1: find your buyer first

Sources
• Government of Pakistan, Pre-feasibility study: Mineral Water Plant (2015), commerce.gov.pk
• nc-machinery.com, water bottling plant cost guide (2026)
Prices change fast. Treat these numbers as a starting point and get at least three fresh quotes.

Disclaimer: This video is for education only. It is not financial or legal advice. Check current rules with PSQCA and your provincial food authority before you start.

Voiceover: AI text-to-speech. Footage via Pexels (free licence): TP Motion, Mikhail Nilov, Polina Tankilevitch, kaboompics, Prakash Chavda, Ivan Fedorych, Thanh Văn, MART PRODUCTION, Oleg Pikhalenok.

title: Start a Masala Grinding Business in Pakistan: Real Cost (2026)
